summary: Session-phase-gated season-data free. Proceeds only when the global session type dword_7C56A4 is 5 (race) or 7 (qualifying). Within that branch, inspects the session phase field this+0x1F78 (this[2014]): when the phase is not 3 and then equals 4, and the half-distance flag byte_8ACFA0 is set, calls ConditionalSeasonDataFree(1) and returns its result; otherwise the accumulated phase-difference value or flag value is returned.

local_names.this: session object whose phase field this+0x1F78 (this[2014]) is inspected
local_names.result: accumulated phase-difference or flag value returned when the free is not performed

operations.description: Session-type gate: dword_7C56A4 must equal 5 or 7 to enter the phase-check branch.
Phase field this+0x1F78 (this[2014]) must not equal 3 (guard:0) to continue toward the phase-4 check.
Phase field this+0x1F78 (this[2014]) must equal 4 (guard:1) for the half-distance free path.
Half-distance flag byte_8ACFA0 must be non-zero for ConditionalSeasonDataFree to run.
ConditionalSeasonDataFree(1) frees season data with literal argument 1 when session type is 5/7, the phase is 4 and the half-distance flag is set; its result is returned.
When the free is not performed, the return value is the accumulated phase-difference value (this[2014]-3 or this[2014]-4) or the byte_8ACFA0 flag value (cast to unsigned byte).
Invoked by sub_4A0760 (0x004A0760), the callers list entry.
